title: Install the first matching Mac App Store app
summary: Quickly install the first application that matches your search term. This is a shortcut for when you know the app name and don't want to look up the ID.

steps.explain: Install the first application that would be returned by a search for the given term.

placeholders.name: SEARCH_TERM
placeholders.description: The name or keyword to search for

steps.expect: The first matching app is installed.

rollback.explain: There is no direct command to uninstall an app via mas. You must delete the app from the Applications folder in Finder.

warnings: This installs the first result, which might not be the exact app you want if the search term is ambiguous.
